name: smwmusic-waiwai-world
title: WaiWai World 2: SOS!! Parsley Jō - Bloody Tears (Remix)
description:
A remix of Bloody Tears, not from Castlevania II, but from WaiWai World 2!

I love Bloody Tears a lot, but I feel like most remixes of it don't do it justice because they make it dull and dreary. I find it works much better as an energetic song. So I slapped a bunch of piano and orchestra hits into it and here we are! And a solo for good measure.
